notes.learning: From 'ìmọ̀' (knowledge) + 'sáyẹ́nsì' (borrowed and adapted from English 'science'). Refers to systematic knowledge acquired through observation and experimentation.

examples: Ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ń ṣàlàyé bí àwọn ohun ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́. (Science explains how things work)
Ó ń kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ní yunifásítì. (She is studying science at the university)
data.subject: Science
